# Module `url`

URL and URLSearchParams (WHATWG URL Standard) as host objects. A URL's searchParams is linked to it both ways:
changing the URL's search re-parses the list, changing the list rewrites the URL's query. Either may be released
first.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/url.widl`.

## Types

### handle `URL` : `Object`

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_URL`).

### handle `URLSearchParams` : `Object`

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_URLSearchParams`).

### enum `URLComponent` : i32

A component of a URL (also used by Location).

| member | value | |
|---|---:|---|
| `Href` | 0 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Protocol` | 1 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Username` | 2 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Password` | 3 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Host` | 4 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Hostname` | 5 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Port` | 6 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Pathname` | 7 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Search` | 8 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Hash` | 9 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Origin` | 10 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
